svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Modern SaaS web stack
svg.desc: Modern SaaS web stack. 12 components in 7 groups. Connections: Web to Next.js app (app.example.com); Web to Cloudflare (API calls); Mobile app to Cloudflare (API calls); Cloudflare to API service (api.example.com); Next.js app to API service (server fetch); Web to Clerk (sign in); Mobile app to Clerk (sign in); API service to Neon (SQL); API service to Upstash (REST); API service to Stripe (checkout); API service to Resend (send email); API service to Stripe (webhooks via api.example.com); API service to Sentry (errors); Next.js app to Sentry (errors); Next.js app to PostHog (events).

text.tspan: Next.js on Vercel serves the UI and Cloudflare fronts the API; Neon and Upstash hold the data while Clerk, Stripe and Resend handle auth, payments and email
CDN and WAF for the API
